invariants.rationale: Tiled map tiles typically use non-negative global IDs, so firstgid is generally expected to be non-negative.
tileElement must be non-null for getChildByName("animation") to be safely invoked.
tileSet is used for lookups and casting, so it should be non-null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
tile's ID is set into the animated tile (tile.getId()), so tile should not be null.
